spans.s: andhāruvā, āndhāruvā (IE 8-5; EI 12), variant readings of arthāruvā or ārthāruvā (q. v.); Od̤iyā name of a tax.

Āndhra-daṇḍa (IE 8-5), a tax; cf. Turuṣka-daṇḍa and Tigul̤a-daṇḍa. There is also reference to ‘an assembly of Āndhra-daṇḍa’, the meaning of which is doubtful unless daṇḍa is taken here in the sense of ‘an army’.
